title: Hentai Puzzle Classic
description:
Hentai Puzzle Classic - this is a new erotic puzzle-game in which you will need to solve different pictures.
In this game there will be 10 different levels and chill and relaxing music.Editor mode• With this mode, you can upload your photos to solve the puzzle from it! And you can change the number of cells!
More information:Achievements• We have prepared new and interesting achievements for you!
Photo gallery• As you progress through the levels, you can open the photo gallery to see your solved girls!
